comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: With 17.4 Adept of Ages title equipped and R11 or higher Handicrafts, this recipe shows up under Aide Production: Handicrafts. It needs 10x Suede, 15x Gold Thread, and x5 Fine Dye. You can make it in Port Royal too, of course. Dunno if the ingredient list is identical or not... Too bad these are notoriety-only gear; they look really nice!

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
Recipe: Ornate pirate's boots recipe
NPC Name: Pirate Ship Crew
Location: Port Royal Mansion (there are two mansions; the correct one is located between the Craft Shop and the Church)
Requirements: Handicrafts R11, Adept of Age (17C P.4) title equipped
Ingredients are the same as those listed above for the Aide Production version of this recipe.
